messages:
Maya: Quick sync — we're getting multiple support tickets where customers see 503s but the console flags them as 'rate limit'. Users can't tell if this was a routing/capacity decision, a tenant circuit, or an upstream model crash. Can we agree a single provenance surface?
Ajay: Agree. We currently conflate a few internal failure types into a single 5xx. Suggest adding a small header like `x-rw-failure-origin` with values: `routing`, `circuit`, `model`, `quota` so clients and support can disambiguate.
Sasha: If we add that header we need telemetry mapping too — otherwise dashboards won't show the new split. We should emit an event `failure.origin` with tags {origin, route, model_version, tenant_id}.
Kiran: UX note: console copy should avoid exposing raw header names. On the dashboard we can show a human-friendly badge: "Routing congestion" / "Tenant circuit" / "Model OOM" + a link to the runbook.
Maya: +1. Also need to decide how this interacts with existing client-facing error codes. Right now clients get `status: 503` + `error_code: INTERNAL`. We should preserve numeric semantics but add a stable `error_kind` field for clients to program against (e.g., `error_kind: transient_capacity` or `error_kind: tenant_protect`).
Ajay: Proposed minimal contract change (backwards compatible): keep http status and message, add optional fields: `error_kind` (string), `failure_origin` (string), and `hint` (short phrase). Example: { "status": 503, "error_code": "INTERNAL", "error_kind": "transient_capacity", "failure_origin": "routing", "hint": "retry-after=10s" }.
Sasha: For telemetry, we should sample full context traces (prefix + route + kv-cache-hit) for ~1% of these failures to detect regressions, and emit counters at 100% for the coarse `failure_origin` dimension.
Kiran: Rollout plan thought: feature-flag the header & JSON fields on the platform first (internal API clients opt-in), then expose on hosted API after one week of metrics. Console UX can be behind a console feature-flag too.
Maya: What about SDKs? We should provide a small helper that maps `failure_origin` -> sdk-level enum so app owners don't have to parse raw strings.
Ajay: SDK change is small. We'll add `FailureKind` enum and surface `retryable()` boolean (true for routing/model but false for tenant_protect/quota).
Sasha: One more: instrumentation naming. Use `failure.origin=<routing|circuit|model|quota>` and keep the older `failure.class` for historical queries, but start backfilling in the next 7d. Everyone ok?
Kiran: For console copy: short phrases + link to runbook. Example badges: "Transient congestion (try again)" / "Tenant protection (contact support)" / "Model error (auto-fallback applied)". We'll draft copy.
Maya: Edge case: what if a request hits a fallback model successfully but the fallback later returns degraded output? How do we surface that? I propose we emit `fallback_applied: true` plus `fallback_reason` and include that in telemetry.
Ajay: yep add `fallback_applied` boolean. If true and the final status is 200 we still tag the request in telemetry as `route.used=fallback` so quality evals can catch regressions.
Sasha: Implementation checklist for infra: 1) enrich response path with header + JSON fields, 2) emit `failure.origin` counter at emission point, 3) sample full traces for 1%, 4) dashboard widgets for split. I'll open an infra PR after alignment.
Kiran: I'll mock console badges and tooltip text and share in #product for copy review.
Maya: Can deploy-bot post a canary when infra PR is merged so we can monitor?
deploy-bot: deploy started: `feature/failure-origin` -> canary group eng-plat-ppd. Build 9832. Check /deploys/9832 for logs. :rocket:
Ajay: Thanks — one more operational: we should ensure the header is scrubbed for PII and doesn't include tenant IDs. Only emit tenant_id in telemetry events, not headers.
Maya: Good catch. Also add a migration note: clients should treat `error_kind` as advisory for 60 days, then we'll begin enforcing SDK helpers.
Sasha: I'll draft the instrumentation RFC and include example queries for dashboards (time series + p95 latency during routing-origin failures).
Kiran: Sounds good. I'll collect the console copy + runbook link.
Maya: Ok I'll own coordinating the rollout. Will follow up with a short RFC and a staging PR. Thanks all. :thumbsup:
